notes: VE is reported with 95% CIs, but the CI method and any clustering by testing site are not stated, so nonindependence is null. Claims of protection rest on CIs excluding 0, coded as a primary CI-vs-fixed-value test; 'Fisher' is a false hit (Thermo Fisher). [review] The Table 1 SVI means (0.6 cases vs 0.5 controls) are set side by side without discussion, so they do not raise the level. Waning is inferred from point estimates with overlapping CIs, which the article itself notes.
view_issues: Table 2 gives 342 negatives for 3-dose Pfizer VE, but Table 1 gives 341 for the same group over a longer period. The article is marked corrected (erratum 2023-03-10); the packet does not show the change.
